what: Parser soft-failure contract is ambiguous for an ID-matching line with an unrecognized vote token
scenario_or_breakage: FINDING_1: MAYBE can be implemented as nonzero because line 20 only explicitly names recognized vote or no ID line; under set -euo pipefail that aborts tally instead of producing PARSED_VOTE empty
suggested_fix: Add an explicit four-case table to scripts/parse-judge-vote-and-rating.sh and .md plus harness coverage: missing args/unreadable nonzero with no PARSED_VOTE contract; no ID match exit 0 PARSED_VOTE empty; recognized token exit 0 PARSED_VOTE token; ID match with unrecognized token exit 0 PARSED_VOTE empty

what: TSV row assembly plans to infer tool slots from filenames, but dispatch can return phase and fallback paths whose basename is not the actual tool
scenario_or_breakage: Codex unavailable can yield codex-vote-output-phase2.txt produced by Cursor, or phase3 produced by Claude; tally currently receives only paths, so the proposed strict filename parse can reject legitimate runs or put a Cursor/Claude fallback vote in the Codex slot
suggested_fix: Pass voter tool metadata or the plan-voter slot manifest into tally, or define vN as slot identity instead of actual tool; add fallback phase2 and phase3 fixtures
